description: The product host (operating/host.py check) over every connected source in one cycle pair on one persistent state directory, each cycle by a new host process object (a restart between cycles), no interrupt: the Portal mirror of every relation of the offline catalog (with its persisted copy), Business Central company My Company (Production) with every entity set of integrations/bc_read.py CAPTURE_ENTITY_SETS, the six granted mailboxes (order-confirmation@, ship@, torontowh@, ap@, receiving@, qclabresults@) through the people-exclusion guard, and the SharePoint libraries the host already captures (QA/QC library, Customer Documents, AGENTS Ontology UseCases), each followed by the incremental projection build. Asserted: both cycles complete, every configured source ran (4 configured, none not run, each at generation > 0), no mail folder restarted, the projection chains and the second cycle rebuilds fewer units than the cold first, the projection read as a principal without any grant shows 0 objects and leaks nothing, and no projected value is in the output. Mail: while PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_OIDS (or PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_FILE) is unset the guard refuses the mailboxes and the mail source reports excluded_people_oids_absent in blocked_upstream: the check is then blocked (expect_blocked asserts every other part), never a pass of mail, and the guard is never widened. Counts, states and codes only.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it (GET only; the OAuth token POSTs are the guard's only non-GETs). Fold-in of every connected API (owner 2026-10-21): Portal, BC, the six mailboxes and SharePoint in one host cycle pair. Teams is not wired here (the config names no teams source, checks.sources_configured is 4). No interrupt or case-resume part (host.cycles asserts those). Mail through the people-exclusion guard: PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_OIDS or _FILE unset blocks the mail source with excluded_people_oids_absent (blocked_upstream part mail, recorded as that code), the check is blocked, never pass; the Portal, BC and SharePoint parts and the projection, trim and leak guards are still asserted by expect_blocked. Known gaps of config-only: (1) the host config takes an explicit Portal relation list, so the list is the offline catalog's (ontology/schema/generated/meta/portal_catalog.json, 104 relations), not whatever the live API serves; a relation the API does not serve fails the Portal source (unknown_relation or relation_unavailable), shown in the cycles' portal reasons and a failed cycle; (2) the host reports a mail source blocked by the guard with a generation that still advances (state partial), so generation > 0 is asserted for every source in expect only, where mail is not blocked; (3) completeness is recorded, not asserted: with capture budgets a large BC set, the item and general ledgers, or a SharePoint walk stay partial across two cycles and resume in the next run.
